effective_for: Prospective pool reviews from 2026-10-10; do not reclassify frozen historical failures

comparison.baseline: Latest verified actual effective pool and its frozen member versions
comparison.construction: Direction-aligned 1%-99% winsorization, cross-sectional Z-score, equal factor signals, top-decile equal-weight long holdings

score_rules.A_B_pool_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of eligible per-factor scores using the explicitly verified denominator
score_rules.ICIR: Mean Pearson IC divided by sample standard deviation (ddof=1), not annualized
score_rules.B: Only completed post-effective observations for the unchanged factor version; historical research is not official B
score_rules.B_denominator_unverified: pending; do not silently assume all pool members or only mature members
score_rules.C_Sharpe: Mean cost-adjusted absolute daily portfolio return divided by sample standard deviation, times sqrt(252); risk-free return is zero
score_rules.aggregation: Compute and clip each complete calendar month first, then aggregate the paired months
score_rules.monthly_nav_reset: Reset the scoring NAV baseline, preserve actual carried positions and cash
score_rules.missing_B_or_official_ledger: Research A+C proxy only; official total-points gain remains unverified

legacy_paid_confirmation.scope: Historical conditional paid-research policy only; not a universal prospective standalone admission threshold

evidence_policy.artifact_binding: Existing file SHA256, candidate definition, pool member versions, window, cycle, groups, costs and source scope
